_comment: Site file for scripts/Deploy-NsSite.ps1 - empty ESXi host to a working Gateway in one run. Paths are relative to this file. See docs/end-to-end.md.

vpx._comment: Parameters of Deploy-NsVpx.ps1 (netscaler-vpx-deploy, cloned next to netscaler-nitro). Nsip comes from 'nsip' above.

parameters.EsxPinnedPublicKey: sha256//<ESXi host key, see netscaler-vpx-deploy docs/vmware.md>

certificates._comment: mode 'files': Deploy-NsCertificates.ps1 with 'file'. mode 'acme': wait for 'certKeys' deployed by netscaler-acme ('acmeConfigs' are printed as commands). mode 'none': skip.
